Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial credit not showing after signup (coupon SEEDSIGNUP)

Update for Kimberly and Jorge — we investigated and issued the credits this afternoon.

Findings (short):
- Root cause: a background issuance worker (issue-processor-1) had its job queue drain interrupted by a Redis eviction after a configuration change earlier that morning. The issuance job for TXN-20261101-98765 was enqueued but never processed.
- Impact: small number of PLG signups between 09:05 and 10:30 PST saw coupons flagged as "applied" in the checkout flow (frontend) but their entitlement events never landed in the org wallet.
- Fixes implemented: retried the stuck issuance jobs, re-seeded the missing entitlement events into the reconciler queue, and added a short-term alert for queue-consumer-lag. We also rolled back the aggressive Redis eviction setting and scheduled a follow-up patch to improve idempotency on issuance retries.

Action taken:
- Manually credited SeedScale org wallet with the agreed trial amount (20 USD) at 15:00 PST. You should see the wallet balance update immediately.
- Created INF-4523 in Jira for the long-term fix and assigned to Infra (Priyom is the owner for the patch).

Jorge — you should now be able to run API calls. If anything still looks off, reply with a quick test call or I can run a quick verification with you. Apologies for the onboarding friction — we know time-to-value matters here.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
